caption: AI Agent Activity
description: AI Agent Activity events describe the behavior of autonomous AI agents.
name: ai_agent_activity

1.caption: Session Start
1.description: The agent has started or resumed a session. Refer to the ai_agent_session_start_info object for details.

2.caption: Session End
2.description: An agent session has ended. Refer to the ai_agent_session_end_info object for details.

3.caption: Subagent Start
3.description: The agent has started a sub-agent. Refer to the ai_subagent_start_info object for details.

4.caption: Subagent Stop
4.description: A sub-agent has stopped. Refer to the ai_subagent_stop_info object for details.

5.caption: User Prompt Submit
5.description: The user has submitted a prompt to the agent. Refer to the ai_agent_user_prompt_submit_info object for details.

6.caption: Permission Request
6.description: The agent has requested permission to make a tool call. Refer to the ai_agent_permission_request_info object for details.

7.caption: Tool Use
7.description: The agent has made or is about to make a tool call. Refer to the ai_agent_tool_use_info object for details.

8.caption: Stop
8.description: A turn has stopped due to natural completion, failure, or interruption by the user. Refer to the ai_agent_stop_info object for details.

9.caption: Compact
9.description: The agent has compacted or is about to compact its context. Refer to the ai_agent_compact_info object for details.
